capability_gaps_identified.title: No pipeline stage acquires or analyzes client-supplied design-reference sites
capability_gaps_identified.detail: DesignReferenceSpec.principles is operator-authored; deriveDesignReferenceIntelligence merges spec-declared principles only. The benchmark's expected pipeline steps 'acquire_reference_evidence' and 'analyze_each_client_reference' have no implementation stage. Real crawl+screenshot evidence acquisition (HttpDonorIngestor) exists only for SEO-Bot SERP-selected donor domains, not for client-supplied design_references URLs.
capability_gaps_identified.impact: With a pure raw input (principles omitted per test purity), client references would contribute zero principles to DesignReferenceIntelligence and the sealed design direction.

capability_gaps_identified.title: normalize-spec.ts drops redesign fields
capability_gaps_identified.detail: buildFlatSpec constructs a fixed key set and does not carry client_vision, design_references, or build_intent from the rich authoring format into the flat spec. Redesign clients must hand-author the flat DomainSpec directly.
capability_gaps_identified.impact: The documented authoring flow (rich source spec -> normalize -> consume) cannot express the redesign intelligence inputs.

capability_gaps_identified.title: CLI does not persist SEO-Bot intelligence artifacts
capability_gaps_identified.detail: CompetitiveLandscape, SEOContentBlueprint, and StructuredContentPackage live only in BuildContext memory; the CLI persists website-build-blueprint.json and page-content-contract.json only. The benchmark driver (benchmarks/quantum-ai-partners/driver.ts) captures them in-process.
capability_gaps_identified.impact: An evidence bundle produced by the stock CLI cannot contain these three sealed artifacts.
